Game Overview

Stickman Reach is a platformer title where guide your stickman across precarious platforms by constructing perfectly sized bridges. With intuitive controls and minimalist graphics, each successful crossing leads to the next, with increasing challenges that test your quick thinking and precision. Hone your skills as levels become trickier, keeping you engaged for hours.
